stance: Technical provenance infrastructure is expanding to cover audio assets before market-wide rights enforcement mechanisms have established practical workflows around them.
adoption_shape: The C2PA coalition moved to publish audio-specific provenance guidance alongside its version 2.5 technical suite, but the guidance remains purely informative rather than an adopted industry mandate.
new_entrants: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity has stepped into the music domain to establish baseline documentation for audio-specific provenance tracking.
watch_for: The integration of this informative music guidance into binding implementation requirements by production platforms and distributors.
